prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity mobile web app north-star composition, portrait 393x852
Primary request: Design the first-use Scan screen for LifeGoods, a Khmer-first packaged-food evidence guide. Composition A is identity-led: compact top bar with a distinctive Open Label mark made from two offset folded label sheets and the LifeGoods wordmark, a 44px text language control, then a large camera permission surface, then one full-width Search by Product or barcode row, then a fixed five-tab bottom navigation ordered History, Learn, Scan, Search, Concerns with Scan dominant in the center.
Style/medium: production-ready mobile app UI mockup, not a poster, not a phone-device frame.
Typography: bold friendly sans with Khmer-safe generous line height; crisp black hierarchy inspired by excellent consumer scanner apps, but original.
Color palette: warm white #FAFAF7, charcoal #17181A, cool gray #6F747B and #D9DDE2, indigo #3658D4 for interactive state, limited mango #F2B84B only in the Open Label identity and Scan emphasis.
Materials: flat paper-like surfaces, thin one-pixel dividers, real-feeling camera preview placeholder, minimal rounded corners, no card stack.
Text (verbatim): "LifeGoods", "Scan a package", "Camera frames stay on this device.", "Start camera", "Search by Product or barcode", "History", "Learn", "Scan", "Search", "Concerns".
Constraints: visitor job must read instantly; no score, no rating, no red or green product indicator, no positive/negative labels, no health verdict, no recommendation, no gradients, no glass, no oversized rounded cards, no decorative food photography, no device frame, no watermark.
